title: ACE Limited - proposed acquisition of Combined Insurance Company of America

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: ACE Limited proposes to acquire Combined Insurance Company of America.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not form a defnitive view in relation to market definition. However, the ACCC considered that the transaction would be unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition regardless of the way the market was defined.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the transaction was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition, primarily due to the presence of a large number of other competitors.
